title: Dhammazedi Bell (lost)
status_note: Sank in 1608 while being moved by raft; never recovered.

place.label: Last known: river near Yangon (very approximate)
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

mass_note: reported as nearly 300 t (BBC, reference); unverified

timeline.event: Seized by Filipe de Brito; sinks in the river from a raft

tiers.everyday: The Dhammazedi Bell was a huge 15th-century bell that sank in a river in Myanmar in 1608. People have searched for it ever since.
tiers.student: BBC reporting (a reference, not an official source) describes a 15th-century bell, reportedly near 300 t, seized in 1608 by the Portuguese adventurer Filipe de Brito and lost from a raft. No official record was found [UNKNOWN].

model.label: Not modelled: a ring, carillon or set has no single bell profile in the cited sources.
